summary: Practise access analysis, acceptance strategies, movement protocols, and incident decisions. Explore this five-day humanitarian access course.
lede: Humanitarian access negotiation training helps humanitarian leaders and field teams assess barriers and plan principled engagement. For access advisers, security managers and coordinators, it covers stakeholder mapping, negotiation preparation, acceptance planning, movement protocols and incident decisions, alongside access monitoring and controls for sensitive information.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who negotiate humanitarian access, advise field teams, oversee duty of care, or coordinate operational security and response decisions.
prerequisites: Experience in humanitarian, emergency-response, programme, or field-security operations is recommended. Familiarity with operational risk and field movement procedures will help you apply the scenarios. No programming is required.
